working_well: Population age 3+ at school or learning institution: 47.8% in 2019 census, 82nd percentile within the peer-group (tier 4) — higher than the peer_group median of 43.5%.
needs_attention: County budget absorption rate: 66% in FY 2024/25, 9th percentile within the peer-group (tier 4) — lower than the peer_group median of 75%.
what_changed: County budget absorption rate worsened by 3.61 percentage points as of FY 2024/25 (was 69.61%, now 66%).
Development budget absorption rate improved by 10.8 percentage points as of FY 2024/25 (was 29.2%, now 40%).
